import{createSlice}from'@reduxjs/toolkit';/* localStorage keys are the same as the plain-JS version: pr:<email> (css),
   pr:sel:<email>, pr:quiz:<email> ([best]) */const read=k=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'[]');}catch{return[];}};const key=(game,email)=>'pr:'+(game==='css'?'':game+':')+email;const slice=createSlice({name:'progress',initialState:{css:[],sel:[],quiz:0},reducers:{setProgress:(_,a)=>a.payload,levelDone(state,a){const{game,index}=a.payload;if(!state[game].includes(index))state[game].push(index);},bestScore(state,a){state.quiz=a.payload;}}});const{setProgress,levelDone,bestScore}=slice.actions;export const loadProgress=()=>(dispatch,getState)=>{const u=getState().auth.user;dispatch(setProgress(u?{css:read(key('css',u.e)),sel:read(key('sel',u.e)),quiz:read(key('quiz',u.e))[0]||0}:{css:[],sel:[],quiz:0}));};export const completeLevel=(game,index)=>(dispatch,getState)=>{const s=getState();if(!s.auth.user||s.progress[game].includes(index))return;dispatch(levelDone({game,index}));localStorage.setItem(key(game,s.auth.user.e),JSON.stringify(getState().progress[game]));};export const saveBest=score=>(dispatch,getState)=>{const s=getState();if(!s.auth.user||score<=s.progress.quiz)return;dispatch(bestScore(score));localStorage.setItem(key('quiz',s.auth.user.e),JSON.stringify([score]));};export default slice.reducer;
